# Dereje Jima

Website: https://www.ddjima.com/

Dereje Jima is a Senior Research Scholar in bioinformatics and computational biology at North Carolina State University. His work focuses on high-throughput genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and multi-omics data analysis, with applications in environmental health, human disease, toxicogenomics, regulatory genomics, and reproducible research workflows.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://www.ddjima.com/
- Full Publications: https://www.ddjima.com/full_publication/
- Publications: https://www.ddjima.com/publication/
- Tools: https://www.ddjima.com/tools/
- News: https://www.ddjima.com/news/
- Contact: https://www.ddjima.com/contact/

## Research Themes

- Bioinformatics and computational biology
- Genomics, epigenomics, transcriptomics, and multi-omics integration
- Environmental health and toxicogenomics
- Genomic imprinting and regulatory genomics
- Reproducible analysis workflows
- Collaborative research support and trainee mentoring

## Research Tools

- Human Imprintome: https://www.humanicr.org/
- temposeqcount: https://github.com/demis001/temposeqcount
- Pathosphere.org / ECBC Pipeline publication: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26714571/
